India Defeats Thailand 7-0 in Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy

The Indian women's hockey team secured a 7-0 victory against Thailand in the Asian Hockey Champions Trophy. This win marks India's third consecutive victory in the tournament, confirming their place in the semi-finals.
